---
title: "NHANES Dashboard"
author: "Aminah Brown-Roopnarine"
date: "2026-10-05"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Step 2: packages and data
library(tidyverse)
library(flexdashboard)

nh <- read_csv("../Data /cleaned_NHANES.csv")

# Average SBP across the four readings (needed for the value box)
nh <- nh %>%
  mutate(
    avg_sbp = rowMeans(
      select(., systolic_bp_1, systolic_bp_2, systolic_bp_3, systolic_bp_4),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    avg_sbp = ifelse(is.nan(avg_sbp), NA, avg_sbp)
  )
```

Row {data-height=650}
-------------------------------------

### Age distribution by gender

```{r age-gender-plot}
nh %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, position = "dodge", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("salmon", "#008080")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Age by Gender",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Row {data-height=350}
-------------------------------------

### Individuals aged 21 or older (%)

```{r gauge-age}
pct_21 <- round(mean(nh$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)

gauge(
  value = pct_21,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  symbol = "%",
  gaugeSectors(
    success = c(80, 100),
    warning = c(50, 79),
    danger  = c(0, 49)
  )
)
```

### Average SBP above 120 mm Hg

```{r valuebox-sbp}
pct_sbp <- round(mean(nh$avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)

valueBox(
  value = paste0(pct_sbp, "%"),
  caption = "of individuals have an average systolic BP above 120 mm Hg",
  icon = "fa-heartbeat",
  color = "orange"
)
```
